# LuaSPortSensor:discover

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.6.3</span></div>

Return true if the sensor is alive and updates its module / band / rx / appId / physId.

```lua
local result = sensor:discover()
```

## Parameters

None.

## Returns

result (boolean)
